Mitigants: offer phasing into two tranches or a modest, cost‑limited protective hedge (~1–2% of portfolio) on a broad tech ETF if the client wants extra downside insurance for the complex sleeve; meanwhile keep any unallocated funds in short‑dated T‑bills.
